storySubtitle: A committed Honua export fixture that replays incident escalations, unit movement, and coverage gaps without requiring a live server.
modeLabel: Fixture mode · no server bring-up required
sourceEnvironment: Committed Honua export fixture for portfolio demos

source.description: Response incidents exported from the Honua incident replay contract.
Timestamped unit positions exported from the same Honua replay environment.
Zone-level SLA gap summaries emitted by the ETL-to-insight path before the demo is loaded.

walkthrough.title: Play the first response wave
walkthrough.detail: Use the time slider to replay the response window and watch active incidents stay in view while unit pings converge on the harbor and Waikiki corridors.

walkthrough.title: Switch from events to coverage risk
walkthrough.detail: Leave the coverage polygons on to show which zones drifted past the SLA threshold even when the raw incident count looked manageable.

walkthrough.title: Connect the replay to Honua exports
walkthrough.detail: Open the provenance panel to show the exact Honua service and layer IDs that produced the committed fixture and the maintainer refresh command.

walkthrough.title: Tell the ETL-to-insight story
walkthrough.detail: Use the KPI cards as the punch line: ETL precomputes the gap metrics, the SDK refreshes the fixture, and kepler.gl turns it into a portfolio-ready briefing.

provenance.summary: The default demo path loads committed GeoJSON exports captured from a Honua replay contract so evaluators can run the story locally without a live environment.
derivationNotes: Coverage polygons already include SLA-gap percentages and median response minutes from the ETL pipeline; the browser does not recompute them on load.
The replay window is anchored to the shared replay_at timestamp field so incidents and unit pings scrub together during playback.
Maintainers can refresh the fixture from a live Honua environment with the documented script when the demo contract changes.
